image_location_description: Center (waistline), 1-brick-tall belt between torso and legs with small front pouch/buckle

steps.title: Lay front & back belt runs
steps.description: Place 2x 3002 ReddishBrown as a 1x6 front; repeat for back, parallel.

steps.title: Close the belt loop
steps.description: Connect ends with 4x 3004 DarkRed (two per side) to form a 6x4 ring.

steps.title: Add front pouch block
steps.description: Center a 3004 ReddishBrown on the front edge, sticking out as a pouch.

steps.title: Buckle + studs
steps.description: Add 1x 3005 DarkRed atop pouch; add 2x 3005 DarkRed as front studs.
